about: C2 critic, step 3: a player who pokes at the killhouse in the ready beat (no men): every door, every room, behind the bar, the lobby, the street to both ends, the warehouse's openings, into the cars and the furniture. Where does the walk stop with no reason to see, what answers nothing?

round the desk to A1

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller; const want = Math.atan2(-(-1.2 - C.pos.x), -(-4.1 - C.pos.z)); return [Math.round(-(Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw))) / C.sensitivity), Math.round(C.pitch / C.sensitivity)]; })()
